purpose: Diagnostic test app requested after the dimension response issue remained reproducible
pr_state: draft pending diagnosis and user acceptance

user_feedback.confirmed_shape_visibility: User reports the first problem seems fixed
user_feedback.dimension_response: User reports the second problem remains; no resolution claimed

instrumentation.activation: Only when LIMO_CAD_SKETCH_TRACE_DIR is set by the separate diagnostic launcher
instrumentation.ordinary_launches: No recorder resource, disk writes, or recording systems
instrumentation.raw_input: Original f64 physical window cursor position before Bevy logical/f32/UI conversion, restricted to the primary application window
instrumentation.paired_readout: Post-layout display_sample rows include the last processed raw cursor, actual visible numeric caption or editor text, control value, generation and pending-edit state
instrumentation.correlation: Raw/input/preview sequence numbers preserve event order, including multiple raw moves received before one controller update
instrumentation.mapping: Window and viewport coordinates, backing/UI scale, camera, sketch raw/acquired/resolved points, anchors, snapping kind and grid acquisition distances
instrumentation.navigation: Raw wheel, pinch, resize and backing-scale changes are recorded without logging keyboard events
instrumentation.storage: Local per-launch JSONL, create_new, private file permissions, bounded nonblocking queue, dropped-record counts, 256 MiB per file, asynchronous disk writes and exit flush

validation.artifact_verification: Separate build-identity.json and startup-verification.json beside the delivered app record exact compiled revision, signatures and package checks

broader_ui_mcp_qualification: paused; prior coverage and documents/recovery preserved
